commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+11' The referee is firm and issues Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) a deserved yellow card.
90+10' 4 - 3 Goal! Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 4:3.
90+10' Ivan Villar anticipates the direction of the penalty by Dani Parejo (Villarreal). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
90+10' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+9' It’s a PENALTY to Villarreal after the VAR review!

90+8' There's a break in play and referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Villarreal using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+8' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+7' The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+7' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+4' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
90+4' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Diego Conde anticipates well and smothers the ball.
90+3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+2' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
90+1' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul after Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.
89' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) for his blatant foul.

87' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Diego Conde, who pulls off a comfortable save!
86' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pape Gueye (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
80' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

80' 3 - 3 Oscar Mingueza sends a superb cross into the box. Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the top right corner, leaving Diego Conde beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:3.
80' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
79' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.
76' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
74' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replacing Borja Iglesias.

74' Fine attempt! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alex Baena walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
71' The referee awards a corner and Alex Baena (Villarreal) goes over to take it.
71' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Ivan Villar makes a smart save to deny him. Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
70' Substitution. Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) has come on for Alfonso Gonzalez.
70' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Javier Manquillo will be replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
64' 3 - 2 This is definitely not what Jailson (Celta Vigo) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 3:2.
63' Alex Baena (Villarreal) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
62' Good defending. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) tries to find Nicolas Pepe inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

60' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Sergi Cardona and scores magnificently from close range into the right side of the goal. 2:2.
59' It is time for a substitution. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is on for Arnaut Danjuma.
58' The substitution is prepared. Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yeremy Pino.
58' The referee signals a substitution. Logan Costa (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Eric Bailly.
58' Here is a change. Sergio Carreira is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
58' That's the end of the game for Ilaix Moriba, who is replaced by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
57' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The referee gives a yellow card to Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
54' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
54' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
52' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had an easy-decision to make.
52' Villarreal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
48' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Celta Vigo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' The attendance is 19651.
46' Here comes a substitution. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Gerard Moreno.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but Diego Conde leaps into the air and clears the danger.

44' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Celta Vigo.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.

42' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
39' Alex Baena (Villarreal) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but slams the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
39' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals. A free kick has been awarded to Villarreal.
38' Ivan Villar makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Alex Baena (Villarreal) after a cross from the side.
37' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a throw-in.
36' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
36' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
32' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
31' 1 - 2 Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) struck the ball from a long-range free kick, and it flicks in off the post. A perfect technical strike!
30' Poor challenge! Eric Bailly (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
29' Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Villarreal.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Gerard Moreno knock down. 1:1.
26' Alex Baena (Villarreal) prepares to take a corner kick.
25' Alex Baena (Villarreal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

25' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The linesman points to the corner flag, Villarreal are going to take it.
22' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will deliver the corner kick.
22' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Alex Baena (Villarreal) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
20' Good clearance! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.

18' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the left side of the goal, but Ivan Villar is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
17' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' Wasted opportunity! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
15' The ball is cleared after Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
14' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
12' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
10' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.
9' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
7' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diego Conde intercepts the ball.
4' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) after he collected a pass and unleashed his shot. He attempted to surprise the goalkeeper, who easily stopped his shot.
2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Villarreal will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
